relations.subject: William Dwight Whitney
relations.evidence: He studied at Williams College, where he took his degree in 1845.

relations.subject: William Dwight Whitney
relations.evidence: In the autumn of the same year he went to Yale, where he continued the study of Sanskrit which he had commenced in 1843.

relations.subject: William Dwight Whitney
relations.evidence: In 1850, he visited Germany, where he spent some years in Berlin and Tübingen at the feet of Profs. Weber and Roth.

relations.evidence: in 1854 became Professor of Sanskrit at Yale, a post which he held during the remainder of his life.
